activity.heading: Activity requirements
activity.lead: To keep the community active and worthwhile, members are expected to:

attend.title: Attend at least 2 gatherings a year.
attend.body: Gatherings include in-person meetings, workshops and social events.

slack.title: Be active in the Slack channel.
slack.body: Join discussions, share experiences and ask questions.

absence.title: Let us know if you will be away.
absence.body: If you know you will be less active for a while, tell the board.

activity.review: The board reviews activity levels regularly. If the requirements are not met over time, the board may get in touch for a conversation about the way forward.

retirement.heading: Retirement
retirement.body: A member who does not meet the activity requirements over a longer period may be retired by the board. Retirement is not a punishment, but a recognition that life and priorities change.

meaning.slack: You keep access to Slack, but lose access to private channels and are moved to a retired role.
meaning.events: You cannot attend roundtable gatherings, but you are welcome at social events.
meaning.vote: You have no vote at the annual general meeting.
meaning.rejoin: You can ask the board at any time to become an active member again.

reinstatement.heading: Rejoining
reinstatement.body: Want to become an active member again? Get in touch with the board. We consider rejoining based on your intent and your capacity to take an active part.

host.title: Hosting
host.intro: Let us know you are interested in hosting. It is not a commitment: the board gets in touch when we plan the next gathering and matches you with a suitable topic and group. The gatherings themselves are booked through Luma.
host.formIntro: All fields are optional: signing up is signal enough. The board sets up the gathering in Luma when it is your turn.

form.capacity: How many people can you host?
form.timeframePlaceholder: e.g. Q3 2026, before the summer, flexible
form.error: Could not register. Please try again.

openToWork.title: Open to work
openToWork.intro: We are regularly asked whether we know someone for a CTO role. If you are in a new situation, or just curious about what is out there, you can mark yourself as open here. By default you are not listed. The list is only visible to members of the investment groups and the board, since that is where the requests come in. You can withdraw at any time.
openToWork.isOpen: You are listed as open to new opportunities
openToWork.notListed: You are not listed. All fields are optional, signing up is enough.

form.availabilityPlaceholder: e.g. now, from January, 3 months' notice
form.notePlaceholder: Industry, stage, remote, what you do not want
form.error: Could not save. Please try again.

security.title: Sign-in
security.intro: You sign in with a link sent by email. With a passkey you can sign in with Face ID, your fingerprint or a security key instead, without waiting for the email. The email link keeps working, so if you lose your device, just sign in with the link and remove the passkey here.

add.heading: Add a passkey
add.headingOnboarding: One more step: set up a passkey for {name}
add.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. You can still sign in with the email link.
add.storage: The passkey is stored on this device (or in iCloud Keychain / Google Password Manager, so it follows you to your other devices). We only store the public key.
add.added: Passkey added. Next time you can choose "{button}" on the sign-in page.
add.signOutAndIn: Sign out and sign in again

list.heading: Your passkeys
list.empty: No passkeys yet. You sign in with the email link.
list.confirmRemove: Remove {label}? You can still sign in with the email link.

errors.loadList: Could not load your passkeys. Please try again.
errors.alreadyOnDevice: This device already has a passkey for you.
errors.createFailed: Could not create a passkey on this device.
errors.duplicate: This passkey has already been added.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the passkey. Try again, and check that your device asks for Face ID, your fingerprint or a PIN.
errors.rename: Could not rename it. Please try again.
errors.remove: Could not remove the passkey. Please try again.
errors.reauth: For security reasons you can only add a passkey right after you have signed in. Sign out, sign in again with the email link (or a passkey you already have), and try again.
errors.limit: You already have {max} passkeys. Remove one you do not use, then you can add a new one.

device.title: Connect an agent
device.intro: An agent (for example the ctr CLI on a box) is asking for access to the portal's admin API. Check that you started it yourself and that the code matches the one in the terminal. Only then approve.
device.boardOnly: Only the board (styret) can connect agents.

scopes.eventsWrite: create events and record attendance from Luma
scopes.surveysWrite: create, close and send out surveys

device.tokenNote: Approving gives this agent a token in your name for {days} days, with exactly this access. It stops working if you leave the board, and everything it does is logged.
device.reauth: For security reasons you can only approve right after signing in. Sign out and sign in again: a passkey brings you straight back here. With the email link, open the link from the terminal again afterwards.
device.signOutAndIn: Sign out and sign in again
device.approved: Approved. The agent picks up its token within a few seconds, and you can close this page.
device.denied: Denied. The agent gets no access.

errors.invalid: That is not a valid code. It looks like ABCD-EFGH.
errors.notFound: No request has that code. Check the code in the terminal.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Run ctr login again.
errors.decided: This request has already been handled.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.intro: Short surveys after our events. They take a couple of minutes, and they are how we find out what worked and what we should do differently next time. The board sees the answers.

create.englishNote: This event belongs to {group}, so the survey will be in English.
create.draftHint: To change the questions, create a draft. You can then edit it before anyone sees it.

errors.load: Could not load the surveys. Please try again.
errors.create: Could not create the survey. Please try again.

admin.heading: Manage
admin.expired: The closing date has passed, so nobody can answer any more. Move the date to open it again.
admin.locked: The questions are locked because someone has already answered. That way the answers always match the question they were given to.
admin.question: Question

answer.notEligible: You are not in the group this event belongs to, so you cannot answer yourself. As a board member you can still see the results.
answer.draft: This is a draft. Members cannot see it until it is opened.
answer.thanks: Thank you! Your answer is saved.
answer.canEdit: You can change your answer while the survey is open.
answer.failed: Could not save your answer. Please try again.

results.boardNote: Board view. Free-text answers show names, because we are a small circle built on trust. Do not pass them on with names.
results.memberNote: You see totals without names. Only the board sees the free-text answers.
results.textHidden: Free text, visible to the board.
